headline: Every vendor and customer contract, owned, checked and billed correctly.
lede: Acme Pay is a made-up payments company, used here to show the template. It runs on a stack of processors, banks and identity vendors, each on its own contract. Bluefyn sits as a layer above that stack, so Acme pays vendors correctly, bills customers correctly and sees all of it in one place.

closing.label: Who we are
closing.text: Bluefyn checks every fee you pay and every invoice you send against your contracts, and shows the transaction, the contract term and the math behind each finding.

closing.label: Why now
closing.text: Every product Acme launches adds vendor terms on one side and customer pricing on the other. Putting the layer in now keeps both right from day one.
